commits.subject: fix(scheduler): use earliest of primary+double-down for fallback deadline
commits.body:
Bug: the scheduler computed its fallback-post deadline as
`primary_pick.game_time - fallback_deadline_min`. When the double-down's
game starts BEFORE the primary's game, that deadline arrived after the
BTS app had already stopped accepting submissions for the day.

Reproduced live on 2026-04-12: morning preview had Luke Keaschall
(MIN, 13:37 game) as primary + Roman Anthony (BOS, 14:15 game) as
double-down. After 12 noon-cluster lineups confirmed, the model
flipped them — Roman became primary, Luke the double-down. The
scheduler then computed fallback as 14:15 - 35min = 13:40 ET, three
minutes AFTER Luke's 13:37 first pitch and the BTS submission cutoff.

Fix: extracted _earliest_pick_game_et helper and used it in both
fallback-deadline call sites (the in-loop wakeup at scheduler.py:707
and the post-loop final fallback at scheduler.py:774). When there's
no double-down the helper returns the primary's game time, so the
single-pick path is unchanged.

Tests:
  - test_returns_primary_when_no_double_down (single-pick base case)
  - test_returns_primary_when_primary_is_earlier (no behavior change)
  - test_returns_double_down_when_double_is_earlier (the bug)
